t1: This is a Next.js App Router app (TypeScript). Integrate Dodo Payments one-time payments: (1) a POST route that creates a hosted checkout for product ID from the request body and returns the checkout URL, (2) a webhook route that verifies the webhook and, when the payment succeeds, calls grantAccess(userId, productId) from lib-db.ts (the userId is passed into checkout as metadata). Use environment variables for secrets. The dependencies are installed. Do not add or install packages. You may run `npx tsc --noEmit` to check your work. Write the code, then stop.
t2: This is an Express 5 API (TypeScript, src/server.ts). Integrate Dodo Payments subscriptions: (1) POST /subscribe that starts a subscription checkout for a plan product ID and a userId, returning the checkout URL, (2) POST /change-plan that moves an existing subscription to another product with prorated billing charged immediately, (3) POST /webhooks/dodo that verifies the webhook and calls setPlan(userId, status, subscriptionId) from src/db.ts when a subscription becomes active, goes on hold, is cancelled or renews. Use environment variables for secrets. The dependencies are installed. Do not add or install packages. You may run `npx tsc --noEmit` to check your work. Write the code, then stop.
t3: This is an Express 5 API (TypeScript, src/server.ts). We bill per API call with Dodo Payments usage-based billing. Add (1) a helper that records one usage event per API call for a Dodo customer ID, with the event name 'api.call' and the endpoint path as metadata, batching events and sending them at most every 5 seconds, and (2) an Express middleware that uses it for every request that has an x-customer-id header.
